name: G7 T3 W01 Part 1 - Find a spreadsheet cell
description: Find a spreadsheet cell. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Matching. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: A line of cells going across a table.
words.example: Row 3 holds all the information about the chess club.

words.definition: A line of cells going down a table.
words.example: Column B holds the number of students in each club.
